recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future detailed TestScript/testing wording changes should be made in the Testing IG unless core's links to that IG become stale.
issue_request: FHIR-12562 was Published/Persuasive for FHIR-core TestScript. It asked to replace the Testing FHIR "How to specify metadata capabilities" statement that unsupported capabilities could skip the whole TestScript or a specific test depending on where capabilities were defined, because the then-current TestScript definition no longer had test.metadata. The approved replacement described a test engine comparing the system under test's conformance capabilities and allowing the TestScript as a whole to be skipped based on that comparison.
initial_application: Git-svn commit 758b8ebf8d8973c81cb6fbd6bae9e4b9462b5ba6 applied #12562 to source/testing.html and records SVN build@10808, matching the Jira resolution. It changed both the preprocessing workflow paragraph and the "How to specify metadata capabilities" subsection.
additional_context: Later Published TestScript work in FHIR-37818 rewrote the same preprocessing area to compare TestScript setup/test action.operation interactions against the system under test CapabilityStatement. In 2025, commit f9a44787c45071394532c7c2ee94d76f30f47387 removed source/testing.html and source/testscript/* from core, removed TestScript/TestPlan/TestReport active core resource entries, and added the Testing IG to source/fhir.ini. Current core source links testing implementation content and TestScript references to the Testing IG. FHIR-I 2025 WGM minutes also support moving testing-related resources into the Testing IG.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The obsolete sentence is absent from current core source, the historical request was applied, and the authoritative detailed TestScript/testing narrative is now outside the core build. A current Testing IG check found CapabilityStatement comparison wording rather than the old placement-based skip wording.
